query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT pl_name), SUM(pl_rade IS NULL), SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL), MIN(disc_year), MAX(disc_year) FROM planets
SELECT substr(pl_rade_reflink,1,200) r FROM planets WHERE pl_rade_reflink LIKE '%CALCULATED%' LIMIT 2
SELECT discoverymethod, COUNT(*) n, SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL) per_null FROM planets WHERE pl_orbper_reflink IS NULL OR pl_orbper_reflink='' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL) FROM planets
SELECT radius_group, tran_flag, COUNT(*) n, SUM(in_rp_sample) rp, SUM(rad_limit_flagged) rl, SUM(per_limit_flagged) pl FROM planets_classified GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL), SUM(pl_orbper<=0), COUNT(DISTINCT pl_name) FROM planets_classified
SELECT radius_group, discoverymethod, COUNT(*) n FROM planets_classified GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,3 DESC
SELECT in_rp_sample, COUNT(*), SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL), SUM(pl_rade IS NULL), SUM(pl_radelim<>0), SUM(pl_orbperlim<>0) FROM planets_classified GROUP BY 1
SELECT pl_bmassprov, COUNT(*) FROM planets_classified WHERE radius_group='calculated' GROUP BY 1

SELECT radius_group, tran_flag, COUNT(*) n, SUM(pl_rade IS NULL) no_r, SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL) no_p, SUM(rad_limit_flagged) rl, SUM(per_limit_flagged) pl, SUM(in_rp_sample) s FROM planets_classified GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT pl_name), SUM(pl_radelim<>0), SUM(pl_orbperlim<>0), SUM(pl_bmasse IS NULL), MIN(disc_year), MAX(disc_year) FROM planets_classified

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL) np, SUM(pl_rade IS NULL) nr, SUM(pl_bmasse IS NULL) nm, SUM(pl_bmassprov IS NULL) nmp, SUM(pl_radelim IS NULL) nrl, SUM(pl_orbperlim IS NULL) npl, SUM(st_teff IS NULL) nt, SUM(sy_dist IS NULL) nd, MIN(pl_orbper) pmin, MAX(pl_orbper) pmax, MIN(pl_rade) rmin, MAX(pl_rade) rmax, MIN(pl_bmasse) mmin, MAX(pl_bmasse) mmax, MIN(st_teff) tmin, MAX(st_teff) tmax, MIN(sy_dist) dmin, MAX(sy_dist) dmax, MAX(sy_pnum) pn, MAX(sy_snum) sn FROM planets_classified
SELECT discoverymethod, radius_group, COUNT(*) FROM planets_classified GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT SUM(in_rp_sample AND (rad_limit_flagged OR per_limit_flagged)) lim_in, SUM(in_rp_sample AND pl_orbper<=0) bad FROM planets_classified
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planets_classified WHERE (pl_orbperlim<>0)=0 AND per_limit_flagged=1
SELECT radius_group, tran_flag, COUNT(*) n, SUM(in_rp_sample) s, SUM(pl_orbper IS NULL) np FROM planets_classified GROUP BY 1,2
